requirements.statement: A signature requires the signer to re-enter their password; the signature token is single-use and expires within 5 minutes.
Each signature records who, when, what it means and why, with a fingerprint of the record; signatures cannot be edited or deleted.
A signed (approved / closed) record is locked against further edits.
Every change to the quality record is logged with before and after values, who made it and the reason given.
Changing an existing quality record requires a reason.
The audit trail can be filtered and exported as a PDF for review.
Readings are judged against the active specification for their stage and grade; failures raise a non-conformance and, where configured, a hold.
Control charts (I-MR, X̄-R, X̄-S, p, c) use limits from short-term variation and mark Nelson rule breaks.
A new reading that breaks a control rule raises an alarm once, optionally with a non-conformance; alarms are acknowledged with a note.
Incoming lots roll up into per-supplier scorecards with a recommended status and reasons; procurement owns the decision.
A supplier corrective-action request closes only by signature after its fix is verified effective.
Controlled documents are approved by signature; exactly one version is in force; superseded versions are retained.
Results recorded by a method whose SOP is not in force are refused.
Read-and-understood acknowledgements are recorded against the effective version.
Incoming inspections are sampled and judged by the ISO 2859-1 single-sampling normal plan for lot size, level and AQL.
Stability pulls are scheduled from timepoints, reminded before they are due, and their results support an ICH Q1E shelf-life estimate.
Cupping supports the SCA CVA and 2004 forms, blind cup codes, calibration against a reference cupper, and panel agreement statistics.
Green coffee is graded by SCA defect equivalents and screen distribution, judged against specs, and voided only with a reason.
Certificates of analysis print in the customer's layout with results, specification and verdict, and carry their electronic signatures.
Each kind of quality alert is routed to its configured audience; route changes need a reason.
Every API call is authenticated; permissions are enforced, and fail closed in hardened environments.
